anyOf.description: The alternative schemas; a value must match at least one. When every arm is a literal, editors show a dropdown.

description.description: What the union is for, when it is written inline; a published schema is described by its page.

params.description: Type parameters that make this schema generic, each with its default schema.

name.description: Legacy: a name some published schemas still carry. New schemas are named by their page.

description: A union schema: a value is valid if it matches any one of the schemas listed under `anyOf`.
